# notifications API

Inbox, rules, channels and push devices.

Base path `/api/v1/notifications` behind the gateway. Authentication, rate limits and the error format are the same for every service: see [Scripting MowDeck](../../guides/scripting.md). Rendered from [`apps/web/openapi/notifications.json`](https://github.com/lukislp/mowdeck/blob/main/apps/web/openapi/notifications.json) (OpenAPI 3.1), which you can also load into any OpenAPI tool.

## Operations

### notifications

#### GET /api/v1/notifications/inbox

**Get Inbox**

The caller's newest notifications, newest first.

| Parameter | In | Type | Required | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `limit` | query | integer | no | min 1; max 200; default `50` |
| `unread` | query | boolean | no | Only unread notifications.; default `false` |

| Status | Meaning | Body |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 200 | Successful Response | `application/json` [Inbox](#inbox) |
| 422 | Validation Error | `application/json` [HTTPValidationError](#httpvalidationerror) |

#### POST /api/v1/notifications/inbox/{notification_id}/ack

**Acknowledge**

Acknowledge one of the caller's notifications: read plus acknowledged (idempotent; 404 for any other id). For a theft alarm, repeats of it (same kind and mower) are silenced for the caller for an hour (`NOTIFICATIONS_ACK_SILENCE_SECONDS`).

| Parameter | In | Type | Required | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `notification_id` | path | string (uuid) | yes |  |

| Status | Meaning | Body |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 200 | Successful Response | `application/json` [InboxItemOut](#inboxitemout) |
| 422 | Validation Error | `application/json` [HTTPValidationError](#httpvalidationerror) |

#### GET /api/v1/notifications/inbox/{notification_id}/image

**Get Inbox Image**

The camera photo of one of the caller's error or theft notifications (404 when there is none: not taken, expired after a day, or not the caller's notification).

| Parameter | In | Type | Required | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `notification_id` | path | string (uuid) | yes |  |

| Status | Meaning | Body |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 200 | Successful Response | `image/jpeg` any, `image/png` any |
| 422 | Validation Error | `application/json` [HTTPValidationError](#httpvalidationerror) |

#### POST /api/v1/notifications/inbox/{notification_id}/read

**Mark Read**

Mark one of the caller's notifications read (idempotent; 404 for any other id).

| Parameter | In | Type | Required | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `notification_id` | path | string (uuid) | yes |  |

| Status | Meaning | Body |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 200 | Successful Response | `application/json` [InboxItemOut](#inboxitemout) |
| 422 | Validation Error | `application/json` [HTTPValidationError](#httpvalidationerror) |

#### PUT /api/v1/notifications/me/live-activities/device

**Put Live Activity Device**

Register what the caller's app installation offers (ADR 0059): the push-to-start token for Live Activities and whether it has widgets. Replaces the earlier registration.

**Request body** (required): `application/json` [LiveActivityDeviceIn](#liveactivitydevicein)

| Status | Meaning | Body |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 200 | Successful Response | `application/json` [LiveActivityDeviceOut](#liveactivitydeviceout) |
| 422 | Validation Error | `application/json` [HTTPValidationError](#httpvalidationerror) |

#### DELETE /api/v1/notifications/me/live-activities/device/{installation_id}

**Delete Live Activity Device**

Forget the caller's installation and its activities (logout; 404 for any other id).

| Parameter | In | Type | Required | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `installation_id` | path | string (uuid) | yes |  |

| Status | Meaning | Body |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 204 | Successful Response | no body |
| 422 | Validation Error | `application/json` [HTTPValidationError](#httpvalidationerror) |

#### PUT /api/v1/notifications/me/live-activities/mowers/{mower_id}

**Put Live Activity**

The app started a Live Activity for the mower: its update token (the server updates and ends the activity with it). 404 when the caller cannot view the mower.

| Parameter | In | Type | Required | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `mower_id` | path | string (uuid) | yes |  |

**Request body** (required): `application/json` [LiveActivityIn](#liveactivityin)

| Status | Meaning | Body |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 200 | Successful Response | `application/json` [LiveActivityOut](#liveactivityout) |
| 422 | Validation Error | `application/json` [HTTPValidationError](#httpvalidationerror) |

#### DELETE /api/v1/notifications/me/live-activities/mowers/{mower_id}

**Delete Live Activity**

The user ended the activity on the device: the server does not restart it during this job and sends it no more updates.

| Parameter | In | Type | Required | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `mower_id` | path | string (uuid) | yes |  |
| `installation_id` | query | string (uuid) | yes |  |

| Status | Meaning | Body |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 204 | Successful Response | no body |
| 422 | Validation Error | `application/json` [HTTPValidationError](#httpvalidationerror) |

#### GET /api/v1/notifications/me/push/apns

**List Apns Devices**

The caller's iOS devices, oldest first.

| Status | Meaning | Body |

#### POST /api/v1/notifications/me/push/apns

**Add Apns Device**

Register the iOS app's APNs device token for the caller (plan feature `notifications.push`); the same token again replaces the earlier owner and name, and a new token of a known `installation_id` replaces that installation's earlier token.

**Request body** (required): `application/json` [ApnsDeviceIn](#apnsdevicein)

| Status | Meaning | Body |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 201 | Successful Response | `application/json` [ApnsDeviceOut](#apnsdeviceout) |
| 422 | Validation Error | `application/json` [HTTPValidationError](#httpvalidationerror) |

#### DELETE /api/v1/notifications/me/push/apns/{device_id}

**Delete Apns Device**

Delete one of the caller's iOS devices (the app calls it on logout; 404 for any other id).

| Parameter | In | Type | Required | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `device_id` | path | string (uuid) | yes |  |

| Status | Meaning | Body |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 204 | Successful Response | no body |
| 422 | Validation Error | `application/json` [HTTPValidationError](#httpvalidationerror) |

#### GET /api/v1/notifications/push-images/{notification_id}

**Get Push Image**

The photo behind a push notification, for the iOS app's Notification Service Extension.

No login: the signed, short-lived URL in the push payload is the credential (it names one notification and expires after ten minutes). Rate limited. The photo is also in the caller's inbox for a day (`GET /inbox/{id}/image`).

| Parameter | In | Type | Required | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `notification_id` | path | string (uuid) | yes |  |
| `e` | query | integer | yes | Expiry, Unix seconds.; min 0 |
| `s` | query | string | yes | Signature.; min length 16; max length 64 |

| Status | Meaning | Body |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 200 | Successful Response | `image/jpeg` any, `image/png` any |
| 404 | Bad link, or the photo is not ready yet (try again). | no body |
| 410 | The link expired, or no photo was taken. | no body |
| 422 | Validation Error | `application/json` [HTTPValidationError](#httpvalidationerror) |

## Schemas

### ApnsDeviceIn

The iOS app's APNs device token (from `didRegisterForRemoteNotificationsWithDeviceToken`, hex encoded).

| Field | Type | Required | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `device_name` | string or null | no | Shown in the list. |
| `installation_id` | string (uuid) or null | no | Stable id of the app installation (a UUID the iOS shell keeps in the Keychain). A new token of the same installation replaces the earlier one, so a device never holds two registrations. Without it (older app builds) each token is its own device. |
| `token` | string | yes | Device token in hexadecimal (case-insensitive, stored in lower case).; min length 64; max length 200; pattern `^[0-9a-fA-F]+$` |

### ApnsDeviceList

The user's iOS devices, oldest first.

| Field | Type | Required | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `items` | array of [ApnsDeviceOut](#apnsdeviceout) | yes |  |

### ApnsDeviceOut

A registered iOS device; the token itself (a capability) is not echoed.

| Field | Type | Required | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `created_at` | string (date-time) | yes |  |
| `device_name` | string or null | yes |  |
| `id` | string (uuid) | yes |  |
| `token_suffix` | string | yes | The last 8 hex characters of the token. |

### HTTPValidationError

| Field | Type | Required | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `detail` | array of [ValidationError](#validationerror) | no |  |

### Inbox

The newest notifications, newest first.

| Field | Type | Required | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `items` | array of [InboxItemOut](#inboxitemout) | yes |  |
| `unread` | integer | yes |  |

### InboxItemOut

One notification of the user.

| Field | Type | Required | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `acked` | boolean | no | Acknowledged by the user (alarms).; default `false` |
| `acked_at` | string (date-time) or null | no |  |
| `body` | string | yes |  |
| `created_at` | string (date-time) | yes |  |
| `has_image` | boolean | no | A camera photo was taken for this error or theft event and is still kept (a day): `GET /api/v1/notifications/inbox/{id}/image` returns it.; default `false` |
| `id` | string (uuid) | yes |  |
| `kind` | [NotificationKind](#notificationkind) | yes |  |
| `mower_id` | string (uuid) or null | yes |  |
| `occurred_at` | string (date-time) | yes |  |
| `read` | boolean | yes |  |
| `read_at` | string (date-time) or null | yes |  |
| `severity` | [NotificationSeverity](#notificationseverity) | yes |  |
| `title` | string | yes |  |
| `url` | string or null | yes |  |

### LiveActivityDeviceIn

What one app installation offers for Live Activities and widgets (ADR 0059).

| Field | Type | Required | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `installation_id` | string (uuid) | yes | The installation id the iOS shell keeps in the Keychain (the same as for `POST /me/push/apns`). |
| `push_to_start_token` | string or null | no | ActivityKit push-to-start token (hex); null when the device has none (before iOS 17.2) or the user turned Live Activities off. |
| `widgets_enabled` | boolean | no | The installation has MowDeck widgets: reload them by push.; default `false` |

### LiveActivityDeviceOut

The stored registration (the token, a capability, is not echoed).

| Field | Type | Required | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `has_push_to_start_token` | boolean | yes |  |
| `installation_id` | string (uuid) | yes |  |
| `updated_at` | string (date-time) | yes |  |
| `widgets_enabled` | boolean | yes |  |

### LiveActivityIn

A Live Activity the app started for a mower, with its update token.

| Field | Type | Required | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `activity_id` | string | yes | min length 1; max length 100; pattern `^[A-Za-z0-9-]+$` |
| `installation_id` | string (uuid) | yes |  |
| `push_token` | string | yes | The activity's push token (hex) the server updates it with.; min length 64; max length 200; pattern `^[0-9a-fA-F]+$` |

### LiveActivityOut

The stored activity (tokens are not echoed).

| Field | Type | Required | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `activity_id` | string or null | yes |  |
| `installation_id` | string (uuid) | yes |  |
| `mower_id` | string (uuid) | yes |  |
| `started_at` | string (date-time) | yes |  |
| `state` | string | yes |  |

### NotificationKind

What a notification is about.

Type: `"mowing_finished"` \| `"mower_stuck"` \| `"battery_low"` \| `"mower_offline"` \| `"mower_online"` \| `"job_started"` \| `"mower_lifted"` \| `"mower_left_dock_unexpectedly"` \| `"geofence_exit"` \| `"blade_maintenance"` \| `"vision_proposal"` \| `"vision_auto_proposal"` \| `"firmware_update_available"` \| `"firmware_update_finished"` \| `"firmware_update_failed"` \| `"tracking_started"` \| `"tracking_moved"` \| `"tracking_stale"` \| `"tracking_ended"` \| `"security_new_login"` \| `"test"`

### NotificationSeverity

How urgent a notification is; channels map it to TTL, urgency or priority.

Type: `"info"` \| `"warning"` \| `"critical"`

### NtfyIn

The user's ntfy target.

| Field | Type | Required | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `server_url` | string | yes | max length 300 |
| `token` | string or null | no | Access token (tk_...), stored, never returned. Omitted or null keeps the stored token; an empty string removes it. |
| `topic` | string | yes | min length 1; max length 64 |

### NtfyOut

The stored ntfy target (without the token).

| Field | Type | Required | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `has_token` | boolean | yes |  |
| `server_url` | string | yes |  |
| `topic` | string | yes |  |
| `updated_at` | string (date-time) | yes |  |

### PreferencesBody

What the user wants to be notified about (`PUT` replaces everything).

| Field | Type | Required | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `all_mowers` | boolean | no | Follow every mower the user can view, now and later.; default `false` |
| `channels` | array of string | no | Channels to use when a target is configured (webpush, ntfy, apns, ...).; max items 10 |
| `enabled_kinds` | array of [NotificationKind](#notificationkind) | yes | Kinds to notify; job_started is off by default.; max items 20 |
| `language` | string | no | max length 8; default `"en"` |
| `mower_ids` | array of string (uuid) | no | Followed mowers when all_mowers is false (each must be viewable, else 404).; max items 1000 |
| `quiet_hours` | [QuietHoursBody](#quiethoursbody) or null | no |  |
| `timezone` | string | no | max length 64; default `"UTC"` |

### PreferencesOut

Stored preferences (or the defaults) plus what can be chosen.

| Field | Type | Required | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `all_mowers` | boolean | yes |  |
| `available_channels` | array of string | yes | Channels configured on this server. |
| `available_kinds` | array of [NotificationKind](#notificationkind) | yes |  |
| `channels` | array of string | yes |  |
| `enabled_kinds` | array of [NotificationKind](#notificationkind) | yes |  |
| `language` | string | yes |  |
| `languages` | array of string | yes |  |
| `mower_ids` | array of string (uuid) | yes |  |
| `quiet_hours` | [QuietHoursBody](#quiethoursbody) or null | yes |  |
| `stored` | boolean | yes | False until the user saved preferences once. |
| `timezone` | string | yes |  |

| `start` | string | yes | pattern `^([01]\d|2[0-3]):[0-5]\d$` |
